/* DEMOGRAPHICS */

SELECT
CustomerID
,CustomerName
,GlobalCIF
,EntityCIF
,CustomerType
,DateOfIncorporation
,MaritalStatus
,Gender
,MobileNumber
,EmailAddress
,AddressLine1
,AddressLine2
,City
,Province
,ZipCode
,Country
,SMEClassification
,LineOfActivity
,IndustryDescription
,Subsector
,SubsectorDescription
,Tenure
,DataPrivacyConsent
,LastKYCDate
,RiskRatingType
,RiskRating
,SuspendedIndicator
,ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,MBKEnrollmentIndicator
,RIBBOBEnrollmentIndicator                                                                                                                                                      
,PayrollIndicator
,GenerationalCohort
,MarketSegment                                                                                                                         
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate 
where CustomerID = 'C00002784'

/* MEASURES */

SELECT
TotalRelationshipBalance_Shared
,TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Shared
,TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Shared
,TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Shared
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Shared
,TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Shared
,TotalCreditLimitLoans_Shared
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Shared
,TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Shared
,TotalFundValueTrust_Shared
,TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Shared                                                                                                         
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate 
where CustomerID = 'C00002784'

/* ACTIVITIES */

--DEPOSITS--
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductDetails, OutstandingBalance_Shared                                                                                                                            
FROM DW.CI_Deposit_Corporate
where CustomerID = 'C00007529';

--LOANS--
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductDetails, CreditLimit_Shared
FROM DW.CI_Loans_Corporate
where CustomerID = 'C00005797';

--SECURITIES--
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductDetails, PortfolioSize_Shared
FROM DW.CI_Securities_Corporate
where CustomerID = 'C00005797';

--TREASURY--
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductDetails, OutstandingInvestmentProrated 
FROM DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate
where CustomerID = 'C00005797';

--TRUST--
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductDetails, AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Shared
FROM DW.CI_Trust_Corporate
where CustomerID = 'C00005797';


SELECT CustomerId, BalanceAmount
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance
ON BNKM.CustomerAccount.CustomerAccountId = BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance.CustomerAccountId
WHERE CustomerId = 'C00005797'

/* SEGMENTS */

-- Telco --
SELECT
count(*)                                                                                                                     
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate 
where subsectordescription = 'TELECOMMUNICATIONS'

-- TRB > 10M --
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID)                                                                                                                     
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate 
where TotalRelationshipBalance_Shared >= 10000000

-- TRB > 10M --
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID)                                                                                                                     
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate 
where TotalRelationshipBalance_Shared >= 10000000

-- ALL CORPORATE CUSTOMERS --
SELECT
count(*)                                                                                                                     
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate
